body:
Closes #711

## Summary

- Reject non-numeric, boolean, non-finite, and negative `dim_compat` tolerances with `ValueError` before parsing dimensions.
- Preserve zero and finite non-negative numeric tolerances.
- Cover NaN, both infinities, negative, boolean, string, `None`, and zero boundary cases.

## Tasks

- [x] Validate `tolerance` as a finite non-negative `int` or `float`, excluding `bool`.
- [x] Add unit coverage for invalid tolerance values.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `/opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dimension_utils.py --no-cov` — 41 passed.
- [x] Full `/opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m pytest` — 2,067 tests collected with no failing-node cache; coverage artifact reports 90.27% line coverage.
- [x] Deliberate-break proof — candidate tests overlaid on `origin/main` fail 7 cases; the same 41-test file passes on this branch.
- [x] Ruff, Black, strict source mypy, and `git diff --check` pass.

## Validation Note

The literal single-file command with repository default coverage enabled executes all 41 tests successfully, then exits on the repository-wide 25% coverage floor because one test file covers 0.66% of all source lines. The focused behavioral gate therefore uses `--no-cov`; the full suite separately proves 90.27% coverage.

## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
In `src/fine_art_archive/parsers/dimension_utils.py:88-120`, `dim_compat()` compares dimensions against `tolerance` with `difference <= tolerance`. When `tolerance` is `float('nan')` or negative, `difference <= tolerance` evaluates to `False` even for identical dimensions (`dim_compat("50 x 50 cm", "50 x 50 cm", tolerance=float("nan"))` returns `('mismatch', 0.0)` instead of rejecting invalid tolerance).

#### Tasks
- [ ] Validate `tolerance` in `dim_compat()` within `src/fine_art_archive/parsers/dimension_utils.py` raising `ValueError` when `tolerance` is non-finite, not a float/int, or strictly negative.
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/test_dimension_utils.py` asserting `dim_compat` raises `ValueError` on NaN, infinite, or negative tolerance values.

#### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_dimension_utils.py` passes with 100% success.
- [ ] Calling `dim_compat("50 x 50 cm", "50 x 50 cm", tolerance=float("nan"))` or `tolerance=-0.1` raises `ValueError`.
- [ ] Deliberate break: remove tolerance validation from `src/fine_art_archive/parsers/dimension_utils.py`, run `pytest tests/test_dimension_utils.py`, and verify tolerance validation tests fail; revert to pass.
